name: floci
description: MCP server and skills for the Floci local cloud emulator: inspect and provision your local AWS, Azure, GCP and OCI from an agent. Unofficial community project.

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Comma separated toolsets to register: core, storage, messaging, compute, ops, marketplace, hybrid, or all. Fewer tools means fewer tokens per conversation.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Set to 1 to remove every tool that changes state. Leave 0 to keep them.

allowed_toolsets.title: Toolsets the agent may enable
allowed_toolsets.description: Comma separated toolsets an agent can switch on at runtime with enable_toolset. Use all to give it full agency, or list a few to cap it. hybrid holds tools that reach real AWS credentials and arbitrary URLs.

decider.title: Decision model router (optional)
decider.description: Adds suggest_toolsets, which asks a decision model which toolsets a task needs. One of openrouter-jev, openrouter-mercury, zenmux-jev, digitalocean-jev. Leave empty to keep it off.

decider_api_key.title: Decision model API key
decider_api_key.description: Key for the provider chosen above. Stored in the system credential store.
